faqs.question: How to i place an order?
faqs.answer: Select dishes from any restaurant menu, customize your order, choose instant delivery or schedule time, and click place order.

faqs.question: How do I schedule a meal?
faqs.answer: Use the schedule banner on the home screen to pick a future date and time slot for your food delivery.

faqs.question: How does the Smart Food Box work?
faqs.answer: Your order is delivered directly to your room's secure thermal food box, keeping your meals fresh and hot.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: You can cancel your order within 2 minutes of placing it directly from the Order Status section.

faqs.question: How can I modify my order?
faqs.answer: To modify items or special notes, contact hotel room dining reception before the order enters preparation.

faqs.question: What should I do if my food is delayed?
faqs.answer: You can track real-time kitchen status in the app or click CALL RECEPTION to speak directly with guest service.
